acceptance_criteria: By default the gesture view shows the camera picture (mirrored for the front camera) with the tracked hands and shoulders over it

A toggle on the picture box (symbol and words, Bild an / Bild aus, at least 44 px) switches between picture with points and points only while the camera runs, without restarting the camera or the attempt and without losing frames; the choice is remembered on the device under its own key
Every state of the view fits 320x480 to 820x1180 without page scroll
approved_by: Lars Moelleken (owner request 2026-11-24 in session: picture on/off button in the gesture view)
goal: The gesture view shows the camera picture with the tracked hands, and a toggle switches the picture off and on.
